text: Who introduced this item, independently of who supplied its values. “explicit”: it is stated in the retained user or source material. “inferred”: it interprets that material, or its introduction is uncertain. “ai_proposed”: a genuinely new item you are adding beyond that material. Reformulating a supplied purpose, condition or concern is not a new AI addition. Use “ai_proposed” only for your own additions after reading the relevant source; absence of a label or figure is not evidence. If source is missing, unread or ambiguous, use “inferred” and preserve that uncertainty. Label your own additions as Olumi’s suggestions; approval does not change their origin or approve their numbers.
